  Topic: The official RFC topics/documents named by the supplied candidate and selection briefs, or the task domain.
- libreoffice: The Document Foundation
  URL: https://help.libreoffice.org/
  Topic: Official LibreOffice document, spreadsheet, formula/chart and export/layout guidance relevant to the requested deliverables.
